about.title: Our Story
about.heading: Huayi Tongshang · Where Craft Meets Daily Life
about.p1: Huayi Tongshang was founded in 2024, born of deep respect for China’s intangible cultural heritage. We believe every herb, every handmade piece and every hanfu garment carries a thousand years of craft memory.
about.p2: The name “Huayi Tongshang” means “the essence of Chinese heritage, traded to the world” — we are the channel for heritage goods, so that crafts once scattered across China’s communities are used and seen by more people. We connect inheritors with users through a modern platform, bringing heritage into everyday life.
about.t1Text: Our founding team travelled deep into Yunnan, Guizhou and Sichuan to visit heritage artisans and gather first-hand material on wellness culture.
about.t2Text: The first 32 wellness products launched, spanning our three categories: herbs, heritage crafts and hanfu.
about.t3Text: Built the Chinese Heritage Wellness Library, collecting solar-term wellness and heritage craft knowledge.
about.t4Text: A brand-new platform with four languages and a constitution assessment, bringing heritage goods to the world.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: ❓ How do I place an order?
faq.a1: Browse the product pages, choose what you like and click “Add to Cart.” When you are ready, open your cart, click “Checkout,” fill in your shipping details and submit the order.
faq.q2: ❓ Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: We accept WeChat Pay, Alipay, PayPal and several other methods. You can choose whichever suits you best on the checkout page.
faq.a3: Shipping is free across the board right now! Every order ships at no delivery charge.
faq.q4: ❓ How soon will my order ship?
faq.a4: Once your order is confirmed, we ship within 24 hours. You will receive an SMS with your tracking number after dispatch.
faq.q5: ❓ How do I return or exchange an item?
faq.a5: Within 7 days of receiving your item, if there is a quality issue you can contact customer service to arrange a return or exchange. Please contact our live chat for the exact process.
faq.q6: ❓ Can the constitution assessment results be used to diagnose illness?
faq.a6: No. The assessment is adapted from the Classifications and Judgments of TCM Constitutions standard and serves only as a reference for wellness care and product recommendations; it is not a medical diagnosis. If you feel noticeably unwell, please consult a licensed TCM practitioner.
faq.a7: The platform currently supports Chinese, English, 日本語 and 한국어. You can switch languages at any time from the top right of the navigation bar, and product and article content is translated along with it.
shipping.title: Worldwide Shipping
shipping.lead: Handmade heritage pieces and herbal essentials, shipped from Hangzhou to every corner of the world.
shipping.domesticText: Free shipping on everything, dispatched within 24 hours of ordering and typically delivered in 2–4 business days.
shipping.asiaText: SF Express International / EMS, charged by actual weight, typically delivered in 5–8 business days.
shipping.intlText: DHL / international postal parcel, typically delivered in 7–15 business days; some herbal products are subject to import restrictions in the destination country.
shipping.noteText: Products made with plant ingredients, such as moxibustion and incense sticks, may require a quarantine permit for cross-border shipping. Feel free to ask our team before you order.
returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.lead: Seven-day no-questions-asked returns, so every purchase feels assured.
returns.rule1Text: Within 7 days of signing for delivery, items may be returned or exchanged provided they can be sold again.
returns.rule2Text: If an item arrives damaged, is the wrong item or does not match its description, we cover the shipping cost.
returns.rule3Text: Opened edible products such as foods, herbal paste formulas and teas, along with custom-made heritage handicrafts, cannot be returned or exchanged unless there is a quality issue.
returns.rule4Text: Contact live chat → provide your order number and photos of the item → ship it back once approved → refund issued within 3 business days of receipt.

home.valuesTitle: How we treat every heritage piece
home.value1Text: Every handmade piece traces back to its inheritor and origin — no vague “heritage” labels.
home.value2Text: Traditional processes kept intact — nine steaming and sunning, hand-tying, hand-carving. Craft is never traded for speed.
home.value3Text: Herbs are harvested by solar term and matched to your constitution — know your body before you choose.
home.value4Text: Heritage should not live only in museums. What you can brew, use and wear is heritage that stays alive.

feat.title: Project Overview
feat.lead: Huayi Tongshang — a four-language commerce platform that connects TCM constitution assessment with heritage-craft recommendations.
feat.h1Text: Based on the TCM constitution classification standard, an 18-question scale determines your primary and secondary constitutions, with a 5-question quick version and a 3-step first-visit guide. Results include score breakdown, typical signs, causes, care advice, dietary guidance and a heritage wellness path.
feat.h2Text: Wellness products are scored by primary constitution (+50) and secondary (+25), multiplied by a specificity factor so single-constitution items outrank broad ones. Heritage crafts and hanfu form a second recommendation layer based on temperament fit, with optional price-range filtering.
feat.h3Text: All 369 UI strings, 32 products and 28 articles are localized in four languages, including per-item translations of descriptions and craft names. Switching language preserves the current page, and canonical plus hreflang tags let search engines treat each language version correctly.
feat.h4Text: Content and user data are separated, so even if the persistent disk is misconfigured the site stays fully browsable — writes fail with a clear message instead of crashing the app. Writes use a temp-file plus atomic rename to prevent corrupted JSON, and production enables gzip, security headers and static caching.
feat.techStackValue: Node.js + Express + EJS server-side rendering; JSON file storage; no database dependency, so it deploys in one step.
feat.techI18nValue: Flat key-value locale tables with t() lookups in templates; field-level fallback (missing language to English to Chinese) so no page ever renders blank or throws.
feat.techSeoValue: Per-page meta description, canonical, hreflang cross-links, Open Graph cards and a sitemap; product and article pages automatically use their own title and image.
feat.techTestValue: Five automated suites: routing and four-language rendering, recommendation-engine correctness, end-to-end business flow, SEO output, and route-coverage self-check — 200+ assertions in total.
